newsitem.title: USA: Miltope gets additional European orders.
newsitem.headline: Miltope gets additional European orders.

text.p: Miltope Group Inc said on Monday it has received an additional $3.5 million order from 3C Communications International SA of Luxembourg, for its durable Internet terminals in western Europe.

Since July 1996, Miltope has received orders totaling $11.2 million for the new product, the company said in a statement. Miltope makes computers and peripheral equipment that are built to operate under difficult environments.
The Internet terminals will be installed in hotels, cafes, pubs and transportation centers to provide Internet access to the general public.
Miltope also said it received a $3.3 million order from the U.S. Navy for the manufacture of SuperBobcat computers, Miltope said.
Since June, 1996, Miltope has received orders totaling $7.9 million from this customer for this application.
